name: AliExpress Scraper API
description: AliExpress scraper API for Python and the command line: product search results by keyword with sale price, original price, discount, units sold, rating, delivery dates and the Choice flag, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: search
commands.help: AliExpress product listings for a keyword
commands.description: AliExpress search results for a keyword — sale price, discount, units sold, rating and delivery dates.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.description: Currency of the prices, e.g. USD or EUR.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Local AliExpress site, as an ISO country code (default us).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many items to deliver at most (1–250). You pay only for delivered items.
